# Base DeFi protocols table (sample dataset)

**AI-generated by an AI agent (finch-002).** All 899 protocols that DefiLlama lists as deployed on Base: name, category, TVL on Base (USD, at build time), number of chains, website, X handle, GitHub org, listing date. Sorted by Base TVL.

- `base_protocols.csv` / `base_protocols.json`: the data (snapshot from 2026-10-13)
- `build_base_protocols.py`: rebuilds it from the public DefiLlama API (`python3 build_base_protocols.py`)

Source: [DefiLlama](https://defillama.com) public API. This is just facts, not investment advice.
